page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, full width, with Hebrew and Syriac lemmas and Latin glosses. Page number top left, running head top centre. No marginal notes. A handwritten mark at the foot is left out.

main_text.p: יִת דְּרָא דְּמָמוֹן Principalem summam pecuniæ, Esth. 4. verf.7.

דרש Ch. & Syr. Quærere, Inquirere, perquirere, Scisicitari, disserere, disputare, exponere aliquid: Item Syrè, Exercere. Pahel דָּרַשׁ Idem. Ethpahel, [illegible, ~6 letters] Qui exercitati sunt in illo, ad Hebr.12.11.
מִדְרָשָׁא Inquisitio, Studium. בית מִדְרָשָׁא Domus studii, Schola, Gymnasium, Collegium. Plur. בָּתֵּי מִדְרָשָׁיָא.
דְּשָׁא Ostium, janua, porta, דָּשָׁא אַחַר Januam claufit, Genef.19.6. Plur. דְּשִׁין, דְּשַׁיָּא.
[illegible, ~3 letters] Syr. Fructus. Ab Hebr. דשא.

דשש Ch. Calcare, conculcare, conterere, comminuere. Pahel דִּשֵּׁשׁ Idem. Hinc דְּשִׁשׁוּ Conculcarūt, Esth.6.1. & geminatā primā radicali דִּשְׁרֵשׁ Idem, Jesa.14.19. Ex Ithpah. Particip. וּמִדְשָׁרֵשׁ בְּתִיוּבֵיהּ Et conculcatur in vomitu suo, vel provolvitur, ut Regia transferunt, Jesa.19.14. Vide quoq; supra דּוּשׁ.
דְּתָא Ch. Lex, Edictum, Jus, Decretum. Plur. דָּתִין, constr. דָּתֵי אֱלָהָךְ Leges Dei tui, Esr.7.25.
דְּתָא דְּתָאָה דְּתָאא Ch. Herba, Herba tenera. Plural. דְּתָאִין. Ex Hebræo דֶּשָׁא.

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac lemmas are transcribed from the scan with vowel points as far as legible; several Syriac forms (Ethpahel, and the Syriac lemmas before entries 4 to 6 and 9) are not reliably readable and are marked illegible. The handwritten mark "Q 3" at the foot is not printed text and is omitted.
